name: Beams
description: WebGL2 background of slanted, glossy light beams that ripple over time, with film grain, bloom, an intro sweep, and a pointer-following highlight. Works on dark or light pages.
contents: Container div holding a full-size WebGL2 canvas
Two shader passes: a beam field pass and a composite pass with bloom, tone mapping, grain and edge fade
behavior: Beams drift and ripple continuously with time
Intro sweep fades the beams in over 1.6 seconds
Light highlight follows the pointer across the page with easing
Pauses rendering when offscreen or when the tab is hidden
Rendering is static (no motion, no intro, no pointer) when the user prefers reduced motion
editableByProps: Beam color, width, angle, wave length, depth, sharpness, twist, brightness, glow and fill light
Animation speed, pause, intro on or off, pattern seed via variation
Grain amount, edge fade, overall opacity, render quality and pixel ratio
Pointer interaction on or off and its strength
Light mode for dark beams on light pages
Background color, className, style and extra div attributes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the grain, bloom or tone mapping look
Change beam shape or lighting model
needsCodeEdit.where: FIELD shader string, glint and lobe functions

needsCodeEdit.change: Raise or lower the pixel budget for the beam field

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable
Listens to pointermove on window and pointerleave on the document element, so the pointer reacts anywhere on the page
Fills its parent (h-full w-full), so the parent needs a defined size and positioning
Pixel ratio capped at 2 and beam field capped at 1.6 million pixels
Numeric props are clamped internally (for example beamWidth min 8, waveLength min 20, quality 0.25 to 1, opacity 0 to 1)
Beams are additive light; on a light page use lightMode or beams are invisible
